clue.text: A divine monarch, Ophidian!

definitions.note: an ophidian is any member of the snake family, used here as a noun

parts.note: a divine is a clergyman, and DD stands for Doctor of Divinity
ER is Elizabeth Regina, the Queen

explanation.surface: An exclamation hailing a godlike king as a snake.
explanation.definitionFit: The adder is a venomous viper, and ophidians are snakes, so it is an example of the class.

clue.text: Protection for those wishing to view

definitions.meaning: a shield or partition that keeps off wind, light or prying eyes
the surface on which films or television pictures are shown to an audience

explanation.definitionFit: A fire guard or windbreak shelters, and a cinema's white display surface is what audiences watch.

clue.text: Rushed around to dance unhampered by clothing

indicators.note: the word for rushing goes around the dance, enclosing it

parts.note: rushed means sped
to trip is to dance lightly, as in 'trip the light fantastic'

explanation.surface: Someone hurried round to a dance with no clothes holding them back.
explanation.walkthrough: 'around' puts TRIP inside SPED; 'to' is only a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Being naked means wearing nothing, so clothing no longer hampers movement.

clue.text: Exhausted convict turning up in Ireland

parts.note: exhausted means done, worn out

indicators.note: in a down clue, turning up means the convict's word is read from bottom to top

parts.note: a lag is slang for a convict, an old lag

explanation.surface: A worn-out prisoner surfaces somewhere in Ireland.
explanation.walkthrough: 'turning up' reverses LAG to GAL beneath DONE.
explanation.definitionFit: Donegal is a county in the far north-west of the Republic, so it lies within the island.

clue.text: She's fortitude personified

parts.note: a quality of calm endurance that also serves as a woman's first name, so a girl can embody the virtue

explanation.definitionFit: Forbearance under trial is fortitude, and the virtue's name is also a girl's name.

clue.text: Many tend to lift their voices when taking a bath

parts.note: C is the Roman numeral for a hundred, many
to tend is to lean or incline
to lift one's voice is to sing

explanation.surface: Lots of people like to sing while in the bath.
explanation.definitionFit: Washing in a tub is getting clean, so bathing is the act of washing.

clue.text: Giving guidance, newspaper leader affected caution

parts.note: the editor, ED, leads a newspaper

indicators.note: affected here means altered, so the letters of caution are rearranged

explanation.surface: A newspaper's editorial urges care while offering advice.
explanation.walkthrough: 'affected' rearranges CAUTION into UCATION, after ED.
explanation.definitionFit: Teaching is the giving of instruction and guidance to learners.

clue.text: The rope is about adequate

parts.note: C stands for circa, Latin for about
able means competent, adequate

explanation.surface: Someone judges a rope fit for the job.
explanation.definitionFit: A thick ship's hawser of twisted strands is a heavy rope.

clue.text: Pollutes the planet

definitions.meaning: the red fourth planet from the Sun

explanation.definitionFit: To blemish something is to spoil it, and the red planet bears the Roman war god's name.

clue.text: Making a living out of nice beef

indicators.note: the answer is made out of these letters, reworked

explanation.surface: Earning a livelihood by selling good beef.
explanation.walkthrough: 'out of' signals a rearrangement of NICE BEEF.
explanation.definitionFit: A church living is a post with an income for a vicar or rector.

clue.text: To strike in a 28 across would be beastly

indicators.note: the answer to 28 across means a going backwards, so the run of words is read in reverse

parts.note: to lam is to strike or thrash

explanation.surface: Hitting someone during an economic slump would be brutal.
explanation.walkthrough: 28 across is RECESSION, a moving back, so LAM IN A is reversed; 'To' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Animal as an adjective describes brute, physical nature, like a beast's.

clue.text: Break when a quarter doze off

parts.note: S, south, is one of the four quarters of the compass
to nap is to doze

explanation.surface: Something gives way when someone nods off for fifteen minutes.
explanation.definitionFit: To crack or snap a stick is to break it suddenly.

clue.text: He's burning to be a baddie!

definitions.text: He's burning to be a baddie!

parts.words: He's burning to be a baddie!
parts.note: reads as someone keen to be a villain, but means a criminal who sets fires

explanation.definitionFit: A fire-raiser is a criminal who deliberately burns property.

clue.text: Top rescue workers put on trial

indicators.note: the letters are worked over, set to work in a new order

explanation.surface: The best rescue teams are brought before a court.
explanation.walkthrough: 'workers' signals that TOP RESCUE is rearranged.
explanation.definitionFit: To bring legal charges against someone is to have them tried in court.

clue.text: Coppers stay to take control

parts.note: copper coins are pence, abbreviated P
to reside is to stay or live

explanation.surface: Police officers remain behind to run things.
explanation.definitionFit: To chair a meeting is to be in charge of it.

clue.text: This is no cure-all!

parts.note: a medicine aimed at one particular illness, the opposite of a panacea

explanation.definitionFit: A remedy targeting a single disease is the opposite of a panacea.

clue.text: Pens will be put among aquatic birds

parts.note: among means in
terns are seabirds

explanation.surface: Writing pens are to be placed among some seabirds.
explanation.definitionFit: To pen people is to confine them, as in detaining them in a camp.

clue.text: The next decade will see several connections made

parts.note: nine is several in number
ties are bonds or connections

explanation.surface: The coming ten years will see many links forged.
explanation.walkthrough: The clue dates from the 1980s, so the next decade is the one after.
explanation.definitionFit: The years ending in ninety to ninety-nine form a ten-year span.

clue.text: A medical man, a mere eccentric idealist

parts.note: DR is short for doctor

indicators.note: eccentric means odd or off-centre, so the letters of 'a mere' are rearranged

explanation.surface: A doctor described as merely an odd visionary.
explanation.walkthrough: 'eccentric' rearranges A MERE into EAMER after DR; the first 'A' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: A visionary with unrealistic hopes is a fantasist or idealist.

clue.text: The man stating rests are essential

indicators.note: read as the letters' essence being reworked, signalling a rearrangement of the words

explanation.surface: A man declares that breaks are vital.
explanation.walkthrough: 'essential' is an unusual signal for rearranging RESTS ARE.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who states or claims something firmly is one who affirms it.

clue.text: Some are catty people, some kind

indicators.note: only some of the letters of the following words are the answer, sitting inside them

explanation.surface: A remark that certain people are spiteful while others are kind.
explanation.definitionFit: A sort or variety of thing is a kind of it.

clue.text: A little one, a really tiny one, is handy

indicators.note: just a little of the words that follow, a short run inside them

explanation.surface: A tiny item, a really small one, comes in useful.
explanation.walkthrough: 'tiny one' just adds to the surface.
explanation.definitionFit: Something close at hand is nearby and convenient.

clue.text: Estimate given by a foolish girl?

parts.note: an ass is a foolish person
-ess is the feminine suffix, as in lioness

explanation.surface: A judgement offered by a silly young woman.
explanation.walkthrough: A female ass would humorously be an ass-ess.
explanation.definitionFit: To evaluate or appraise something is to estimate its value.

clue.text: Minister holding opposition leader in grudging regard

indicators.note: the word for grudging regard holds the leading letter inside it

parts.note: envy is grudging admiration of another's luck

indicators.note: the leader of opposition is its first letter

explanation.surface: A government minister looks on rivals with resentment.
explanation.definitionFit: A diplomatic envoy ranks below an ambassador and is formally a minister.

clue.text: Save to get fabric with soft finish

parts.note: scrim is a loosely woven cotton fabric
P is piano, soft in music

explanation.surface: Economising by buying cloth with a gentle finish.
explanation.walkthrough: 'with ... finish' places P at the end; scrim is used for curtains and theatre gauze.
explanation.definitionFit: To economise stingily is to skimp and save.

clue.text: Manual workers may well find painting is the answer

parts.note: painting is a form of art
ANS is an abbreviation of answer

explanation.surface: Labourers might find art is the solution to their problems.
explanation.definitionFit: Craftsmen skilled with their hands are manual workers.

clue.text: Colour isn't a problem

indicators.note: a problem means the letters are in trouble and must be rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone insists that colouring causes no difficulty.
explanation.definitionFit: To dye or tint wood is to colour it.

clue.text: Decline touching submission

parts.note: re means concerning, touching on
a cession is a yielding or surrender

explanation.surface: Refusing anything to do with surrender.
explanation.definitionFit: An economic downturn is a decline in trade.
